about_page.title: An agency built for brands that sell desire.
about_page.sub: Born from the industry. Grown with it.
about_page.story: Explore Digital was born from the conviction that hospitality and experience brands deserve an agency that truly understands the industry, not one that just applies generic templates. We built our expertise within the universe that demands identity, emotion, and desire.
about_page.story2: We work along the coast of Ceará and Rio Grande do Norte: Preá, Ilha do Guajirú and Pipa. We work in Portuguese, English and Spanish, because much of the guest and owner base on this coast comes from abroad.
about_page.v1_desc: We only work with hospitality on the coast of Ceará and Rio Grande do Norte. That makes us better at what matters most to you.
about_page.v2_desc: We don't sell impressions. We sell direct bookings, qualified leads, and real measurable growth.
about_page.v3_desc: You know what's being done, why, and what results it's generating. Always, no asterisks.

about_page.ct2_bio: Video capture, editing and visual storytelling. Specialist in content for social media.
about_page.ct3_bio: Design partner. Over a decade in branding and visual identity.
about_page.pt1_bio: Paid traffic management on Google and Meta, focused on ROI and qualified lead generation.
about_page.team_desc: Strategy, creation, production and sales at the same table. Everyone talks to clients, everyone ships.
about_page.pt2_bio: Traffic manager specialised in e-commerce, Meta Ads and Google Ads.

about_page.partners_desc: For paid media we work with specialists who run their own operations. You get the depth of people doing this all day, without losing the Explore team as your single point of contact.
about_page.design_title: Brand work by people who have done it for a decade.
about_page.design_desc: For branding and visual identity we work with a partner studio. Same model as performance: a specialist running their own operation, with Explore as your single point of contact.
about_page.cta_title: Want Explore looking after your brand?

about_page.meta_description: An agency specialised in hospitality on the coast of Ceará and Rio Grande do Norte, Brazil. Our story, our values and the team behind the work.
about_page.estudio_title: Before doing marketing for hospitality, we ran hospitality.
about_page.estudio_p1: A hostel and a surf school, hands on the operation. Before Explore Digital existed, this team had already dealt with empty rooms in the low season, guests complaining about breakfast and an OTA taking a quarter of every booking. We did not study the problem, we lived in it.
about_page.estudio_p2: That is why the conversation starts with occupancy and direct bookings, not reach and engagement. Anyone who has run the operation knows which number pays the bills.
about_page.estudio_p3: We work fully online, and we travel when a client needs the experience captured on location.

plano.meta_title: Action plan for guesthouses, hotels and beach clubs · Explore Digital
plano.meta_description: Three weeks, three sessions and one document with the priorities for the next 90 days: what to do, in what order, and what to ignore. Three slots a month, because the two partners do the work themselves.
plano.og_title: Action plan for hospitality and experiences
plano.og_description: Three weeks, three sessions and a 90 day plan that stays with you. Three slots a month.
plano.hero_title_accent: What is missing is where to start.
plano.hero_sub: The audit shows you the picture. The action plan tells you what to do with it: the priorities for the next 90 days, in order, with what can wait kept separate from what cannot.
hero_bullets: A document that stays with you
Credited against your first monthly fee if you sign within 30 days
plano.hero_cta: I want one of the three slots
plano.preco_nota: One off payment. The full amount is credited against your first monthly fee if you hire Explore within 30 days.
plano.problema_title: There is no shortage of things to do. There is a shortage of order.
plano.problema_sub: Every guesthouse owner has been told they need a new website, reels, ads, review replies and a way off Booking. All at once, with nobody saying what comes first.

problema_items.title: Money spread thin
problema_items.desc: A budget split across five fronts at once moves none of them.

problema_items.title: Commission that never drops
problema_items.desc: The OTA keeps taking the same cut because the direct booking path was never built.

problema_items.title: Low season by surprise
problema_items.desc: By the time occupancy drops it is late to start building demand.

semanas_items.title: Diagnosis
semanas_items.desc: A one hour interview with you, a full sweep of your digital presence and a read on three direct competitors in your destination. Without that the plan is guesswork.

semanas_items.title: The plan
semanas_items.desc: The document is delivered and we spend an hour walking you through it. The priorities for the next 90 days: what to do, in what order, and what to ignore.

semanas_items.title: Course correction
semanas_items.desc: An hour reviewing what actually ran and fixing what needs fixing. If little got off the page, the conversation is about unblocking it, not about scolding.

plano.ignorar_title: What to ignore over the next 90 days.
plano.ignorar_body: You are bombarded with things to do, and almost every list that reaches you only adds. This plan also subtracts: what can wait, what does not apply at your size and what would only make sense after something else happens first.
plano.ignorar_body_2: That is usually the part that saves more money than the list of things to do.
plano.entrega_body: The plan is written to be used after we leave the call. It is yours, and it works whether Explore executes it or you hand it to someone else.
entrega_items: The priorities for the next 90 days, in order
What to ignore, with the reason for each
The read on three direct competitors in your destination
What changes in the direct booking path
What has to be ready before high season
plano.quem_title: Not every business needs this right now.

quem_items.title: Already trading and tired of improvising
quem_items.desc: You have guests, you have revenue, and marketing decisions today are made on impulse.

quem_items.title: Too dependent on OTAs
quem_items.desc: The commission hurts and direct booking was never built on purpose.

quem_items.title: Limited budget that has to land
quem_items.desc: You cannot test five fronts at once and see which one sticks.

plano.quem_nao_title: It is not for you if
quem_nao_items: The business has not opened yet and there is no operation to diagnose
You already know exactly what you want and only need execution
You expect someone to execute the plan within the three weeks
plano.quem_nao_note: We would rather say this now than take one of the three monthly slots for nothing.
plano.vagas_title: Three a month, and the reason is simple.
plano.vagas_body: The diagnosis, the writing and the presentation are done by the two partners. This is not marketing scarcity: it is what fits in a month without the quality dropping.

faq_items.q: Do I need the free audit first?
faq_items.a: No. It helps, because part of the picture arrives ready, but the diagnosis behind the plan goes deeper and is done from scratch either way.
We can, and that is where the credit comes in. But the plan is yours and it works in anyone’s hands: some of our clients run it with their own team.

faq_items.q: What if nothing got done by week 6?
faq_items.a: The third session still stands. We review what blocked it and adjust the plan to what your operation can realistically do.
If you hire any recurring Explore service within 30 days of the plan being delivered, the R$ 997 is credited in full against your first monthly fee.

plano.final_title: Your next season is being decided right now.
plano.final_sub: There are three slots a month. If this month is already taken, we will tell you straight away.
plano.final_note: One off payment · credited against your first monthly fee within 30 days
